removed.text: The EUCC scheme allows ICT suppliers who wish to showcase proof of assurance to go through an EU commonly understood assessment process to certify ICT products such as technological components (chips, smartcards), hardware and software.

removed.name: With EUCC, the EU commonly agreed on assessment process to certify ICT products such as technological components, hardware and software. The scheme is based on Common Criteria, an international standa
removed.text: With EUCC, the EU commonly agreed on assessment process to certify ICT products such as technological components, hardware and software. The scheme is based on Common Criteria, an international standard (ISO/IEC 15408) broadly used internationally.

removed.text: In case the applicant defines the security target based on a non-EUCC certified PP (option b), the certification body (CB) takes full responsibility for the certification results.
